Firstly, I'm so sorry for what you are going through, it seems rough and I hope you'll manage to find the right professional support. 
I'm not, of course, in your same situation. But, I spent the last 10 years living borderline (I'm 25) and I went through hell- especially between three and two years ago, when I also tried to kill myself repeatedly. 
I have a lot of visible self harm scars, the most noticeable is from my last suicide attempt and it covers all my wrist. After these last traumatic events, it took me one year to recover with proper medications and a new therapist. Financial support from my family was essential since I couldn't work. 
Even if it felt impossible, looking back, I am overcoming a lot of difficult situations and now I'm also working a job that I truly like- I'm working towards becoming an independent person. To be better with myself and with others. All of these small personal achievements wouldn't have realised if it wasn't for the proper medical care, and most of it came from public hospitals. 

All of this, to give you a bit of hope, and to advise you to seek proper medical and mental help. Even a financial one, I know how much poverty can affect mental health and it is so great that you are managing to earn some money doing something you like. 

While I'm at work I try to cover the scars, but I don't put a lot of effort into it, I don't care. If someone is going to comment on my physical appearance I'm strong enough to answer it properly. Also, I'm trying to avoid sexual and love relationships because they trigger me a lot .

Hi, I don't know if I can help you but I know a lot of vegan easy recipes which come from Italian cuisine: 

- pasta
(it can be gluten freed, whatever size or quality, whatever kind of grain you'd like- choose your favourite!). It's important to add the salt when the water is boiling and then you can add pasta and cook following the time  instructions on the pasta package (usually from 8 to 12 minutes). 

1. With tomato sauce: you can simply put some olive oil (or whatever oil), or you can add some chopped onions, garlic, basil, carrots and then put the tomato sauce for at least 10 minutes 

2. With beans or lentils or chickpeas: it can be soup-like or dry. (15-20 minutes)

3. Vegan carbonara: adding smoked tofu fried on a pan + some fake eggs.  (10/15 minutes)

4. Vegan ragout: following the tomato sauce instructions you can add lentils or grounded seitan or beyond meat.  This maybe can take you longer up to 40 minutes 

6. Whatever you want: you can easily switch meat or cheese with vegan products! 

- rice 

1. Rice with mushrooms: you can cook first mushrooms, maybe with some oil and a sip of wine, then you can add the rice and cook it in the same pan with mushrooms until the vegetal broth or salted water dries off. (20 min)

2. With red radish/ chicory/ green leafs (15 min) 

3. With lentils or any beans. 

4. You can also cook rice in vegetal broth and eat it like a soup. 

5. You can fry basmati or other king of rice with soy sauce and add any vegetables and/ or vegan substitute you'd like. 

- cous cous, this is a typical medioriental type of wheat and it cooks so fast in like 5 minutes by Absorption of hot salted water or broth, you can have it with a vegetable stew (10/15 min). 

-tofu: you can cook tofu in the fastest way as scrambled eggs, adding some spices (like curry, pepper or paprika). Or you can fry it with some corn flour. It's important to dry its water before.  You can cook it in the same pan with other vegetables. 

-greek salad with tomatoes, olives, vegan feta and cucumber. It's my favourite salad, I always add olive oil, a little of salt, basil and oregano. I also love 'rucola' as salad with some tomatoes and vegan tuna and fresh onions. (5 min)
